cpp.cppWelfare: Contractor to confirm suitable welfare arrangements before works commence, including access to toilet facilities, washing facilities and drinking water.
cpp.cppAccess: Access route to be agreed with the occupier prior to commencement. Work area to be kept secure, tidy and free from avoidable trip hazards.
cpp.cppDeliveries: Materials to be delivered and stored safely without obstructing access. Waste to be removed from site and disposed of by licensed carrier where applicable.
cpp.cppSiteRules: No smoking inside the property. Maintain safe access for occupants. Isolate services where required. Keep tools and materials secure. Report hazards, incidents or changes in scope immediately.
cpp.cppHazards:
Working at height where applicable: use suitable access equipment and follow current safety requirements.
Manual handling: assess loads and use assistance where required.
Dust and debris: use suitable PPE, dust suppression and housekeeping.
Electrical services: isolate or protect services before intrusive works.
Occupier interface: segregate work area from occupants, children and pets where practicable.
cpp.cppPpe: Safety footwear, gloves, eye protection, dust mask/respiratory protection and any task-specific PPE required by the contractor's risk assessment.
